messages:
Anna: quick sync — we need to lock the launch gates for the Temporal initiative (customer-driven onprem burst + HSM). proposing a minimal set: 1) security sign-off (HSM + threat model), 2) infra capacity pin + autoscale smoke, 3) runtime quantization + kernel validation, 4) 10% canary + rollback plan. who can own each?
Sam: +1. can you share expected qps/throughput and payload sizes? runtime needs those for kernel selection tests and continuous-batching config.
Anna: payload ~ 1.2k tokens avg, peak 120 qps sustained for customer window, burst to 600 qps for 30s. doc: https://redwood.internal/temporal-launch (WIP)
Li: infra notes — VPC peering + egress routes ok, but prewarm and KV cache persistence look new. need to validate autoscaler can handle 600->120 without token loss. timeline: need 2 full weeks for perf tests + one weekend for migration tests.
Devon: security — HSM integration requires key escrow review and an HSM acceptance checklist. SOC artifacts + threat model needed; expect ~3 weeks unless scope narrowed. also need a list of flows that will touch customer secrets.
Jen: product — acceptance criteria: 95th latency <= 450ms for gen calls at 10% canary, error budget <0.5% sustained. must have rollback toggle and clear customer communication script.
Sam: runtime plan: spike to validate 8-bit quantized model on our pod config (gputype v2-16). owners: Sam (kernel tests), Li (autoscale/perf), Devon (hsm checklist), Anna/Jen (canary plan). estimate: 6 business days for kernel + batch tuning, 4 days for canary infra.
Li: I can own autoscale smoke + prewarm testing. need a list of traffic curves; canary should exercise cold-starts. also we need emergency capacity headroom; recommend +20% reserved.
Devon: if we limit HSM integration surface (only sign/encrypt for keys, no secret writebacks), I can fast-track review to 10 days. otherwise 3 weeks. pls indicate scope in the doc.
Anna: heard — updating doc with narrower HSM scope option. putting owners and dates into the project board now.
deploy-bot: scheduled a deploy window probe: /deploy probe temporal-staging 2026-05-17T02:00Z -> results expected +24h
Sam: also propose a short perf harness: run 30m sustained at 120qps, then 3x bursts to 600qps. capture p50/p95/p99 and OOM events. I'll attach script to the doc.
Jen: can we make the canary gating automated? e.g., if p95 > 600ms for 5m then auto-rollout-failed. we should have the policy in the console before canary.
Li: we can add a rollout policy in console; requires a config change but doable. timeline +1 day after perf tests.
Devon: add a checklist item: runtime tracing + sampling to prove no sensitive payloads are logged during canary. security won't sign off if traces include raw prompts.
Anna: good catch. adding trace-sampling rule to acceptance. final ask: please reply with firm owners + dates by EOD today so I can lock launch gates for PM review.
Sam: Sam — owner for kernel/perf tests, done by 2026-05-10.
Li: Li — autoscale + canary infra, done by 2026-05-12.
Devon: Devon — security HSM + trace review, targeting 2026-05-20 (fast-track option to 2026-05-12 if scope limited).
Jen: Jen — canary plan + customer comms, done by 2026-05-11.
Anna: thanks all — I'll publish the gated checklist and book a 30m alignment slot tomorrow 09:30 PT. if any blockers surface ping me directly. :thumbsup:
